¿Qué es la cartera tangente y cómo se ob: What is the tangency portfolio and how is the CAPM obtained?
La tangente maximiza el ratio de Sharpe: The tangency portfolio maximizes the Sharpe ratio (μ − rf)/σ. If the market is that portfolio, the return required of an asset is rf + β·(μM − rf), with β = σiM/σM². An asset with an expected return above that figure has a positive alpha.

Una cartera de pesos $w$ rinde $μ_p = w^: A portfolio with weights $w$ yields $μ_p = w^T·μ$ and has risk $σ_p = √(w^T·Σ·w)$. Since assets do not move entirely together (correlation below 1), splitting the money lowers the risk without lowering the return: that is diversification. Of all possible portfolios, the efficient ones are those that give the highest return for each level of risk; together they form the efficient frontier. The minimum-variance one is its leftmost point.
Si además existe un activo sin riesgo co: If there is also a risk-free asset with return $r_f$, the best risky portfolio is the one that maximizes the Sharpe ratio $S = (μ_p − r_f)/σ_p$, the tangency portfolio. Mixing it with the risk-free asset traces the capital market line $μ_p = r_f + S·σ_p$, and all investors choose the same risky portfolio; only how much they lend or borrow changes.
Si el mercado es la cartera tangente, la: If the market is the tangency portfolio, the return the market requires of an asset depends only on its beta, the part of its risk that cannot be eliminated by diversifying. The return-beta line is the security market line (SML). The alpha $α_i = μ_i − (r_f + β_i(μ_M − r_f))$ measures how much more or less it yields relative to that line.
Con ventas en corto los pesos pueden ser: With short selling the weights can be negative and everything has a closed-form solution. Without it ($w_i ≥ 0$) you have to test which assets enter the portfolio; the tool does so with every possible group, so the result is exact. It is a theoretical model: it uses estimates of return and risk that change, and it is not investment advice.

Sin costes de transacción, sin impuestos: No transaction costs, no taxes and infinitely divisible assets.
Correlaciones constantes, y el resultado: Constant correlations, and the result is exact only within the model: without short selling all groups of assets are tested (up to 6); with short selling they come from the closed form.
Por defecto <b>no se permiten ventas en: By default short selling is not allowed (weights ≥ 0, no leverage); with the «Allowed» option the weights can be negative. The active mode always appears in the results.
La rentabilidad objetivo es opcional; si: The target return is optional; without short selling it must lie between that of the lowest-yielding asset and that of the highest. With two assets, the correlation can be +1 or −1 (special classroom cases).
Trabaja con 2 a 6 activos y con las rent: It works with 2 to 6 assets and with the returns, volatilities and correlations you enter: it does not estimate them from historical prices.
